_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in 138 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'Although COVID-19’s negative impact on our business, operations, and financial results has significantly decreased since 2020, we are continuing to see some of the foregoing effects and could see additional effects in the future'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic downturns and other global, national, and regional conditions and events could further impact our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2022 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management, franchising, and licensing, we own or lease very few of our lodging properties (less than one percent of our system)'; 'We are a worldwide operator, franchisor, and licensor of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in 138 countries and territories under 30 brand names'; 'Although COVID-19’s negative impact on our business, operations, and financial results has significantly decreased since 2020, we are continuing to see some of the foregoing effects and could see additional effects in the future'; 'Our industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully for guests'; 'Our hotel brands and other lodging offerings generally compete with major hotel chains, regional hotel chains, independent hotels, and home sharing and rental services across national and international venues'; 'Economic downturns and other global, national, and regional conditions and events could further impact our business, financial results and growth'; 'An increase in the use of third-party Internet services to book online hotel reservations could adversely impact our business' (its own FY2022 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.69x; +13% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.10; conservative 2yr +32%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -29.4%/yr (worst year FY13-FY22 ex-FY20, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.8%/yr (Q2 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.4%/yr (FY13-FY22 ex-FY20 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +40.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY22 ex-FY20); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2023-07-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.69x (54.2% downside to Bear $85 / +78.8% upside to Bull $332) | Adj composite 4.02 vs market 1.92: gap +2.10 [UNDERVALUED] | +13% above the EPP floor $164 (20x FY23E $8.20) | Conservative 2-yr case: +31.8% total (+15.9%/yr) | At 22.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $246 sits at or below the BASE case; North American RevPAR +31.3% in Q1 2023, forward fee revenue +12.3-14.17% (Q2 2023 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
